metadata.title: Constant Chern holomorphic sectional curvature on two-step solvmanifolds
metadata.abstract: Let $M=\Gamma\backslash G$ be a compact solvmanifold with a left-invariant Hermitian structure whose Lie algebra is two-step solvable. If the Chern holomorphic sectional curvature is constant, then the derived algebra is $J$-invariant and the Chern connection is flat. At the Lie-algebra level, we also prove that constant Chern holomorphic sectional curvature is impossible for a unimodular two-step solvable Hermitian Lie algebra of mixed Freibert-Swann type.

analysis.progressType: 两步可解 Hermitian 曲率刚性
analysis.workSummary: 对带左不变 Hermitian 结构的紧可解商 Γ\G，若 Lie 代数两步可解且 Chern 全纯截面曲率为常数，则导出代数 J 不变、Chern 联络平坦。Lie 代数层面另排除 unimodular、两步可解、mixed Freibert–Swann 型具有常 Chern 全纯截面曲率的可能。
techniques: 两步可解 Lie 代数
analysis.breakthrough: 在非 Kähler 齐性环境中由常全纯截面曲率提升到 Chern 平坦，并排除一个混合类型。
analysis.limitations: 紧商、左不变和两步可解是重要限制；Chern 平坦不等于 Riemannian 平坦。Lie 代数排除结论另需 unimodular 及指定类型。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
